"Tell me and I forget, teach me and I may remember, involve me and I learn. "
Benjamin Franklin
Every child has the innate capacity for creative self-construction following a path of natural human development.
What differs is that every child has a unique path to follow in order to fulfil individual potential.
At Woodside we offer a prepared environment with concrete learning materials and carefully selected activities to engage each child.
All we do is rooted in care for the wellbeing of our children.
